CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Disk Usage (duc)** packages [duc](https://duc.zevv.nl), the disk usage indexer and browser, as an Unraid plugin.
duc scans your shares and disks on a schedule and saves the results to an index, so you can browse usage straight away from the webGUI (Settings → User Utilities → Disk Usage) or with `duc ui` in the terminal. It doesn't rescan the disks every time you look.
For help, please post in the [support thread](https://forums.unraid.net/topic/200807-plugin-disk-usage-duc/). Source code, bug reports and release notes are on [GitHub](https://github.com/jamesfreeman959/unraid-duc).
